representation: Selected normalized SDK call fields and snake_case REST body fields, following Pricing authoring DTOs. Metadata/header binding is specified in CONTRACTS.md; existing event payload camelCase and published response annotations retain their design names. No production serializer is delivered.

CreateOrder.semantics: Empty draft; actor and sales_path derived from trusted context; no caller IDs, lines, pin or total.

ListOrders.semantics: Selected query names for existing filters only: created_from inclusive, created_to exclusive, state_entered_before inclusive (has remained in current state since that instant or earlier); state exact; contract_id exact. Fixed collection-specific sorts, no client-selected sort.

HeaderPatch.semantics: Named fields alone choose write versus edit. Empty/unknown fields are boundary-invalid; mixed classes are checked only after engine admissibility.

LinePatch.semantics: As HeaderPatch; line membership is checked against working/current version before slice classification guards.

AddLine.semantics: Dates/term intent may remain absent in draft. No external_reference here; separate admin PATCH.

PreviewBasket.semantics: Nonbinding Pricing assessment; optional term/cycle missing withholds TCV; no receipt, hold, attempt, authoritative deadline or approval verdict.

Amendment.semantics: Delta is nonempty commercial authored content; missing/invalid reason is registered amendment-reason-invalid guard; frozen axes and administrative changes refused.

Cancel.semantics: Reason required for every cancellation through the registered guard, after state/version admissibility; never an actor-specific bypass.

ForcedFailure.semantics: Two distinct break-glass users; missing reason is a registered guard refusal. Never caller-selected failure_reason or success compensation assertion. S5-01 binds freshness to exact audit generation.

Acceptance.semantics: accepted_at and recorded_by are server facts, not authored. Current immutable version only; party bars use actual sparse submit/amendment actors.

ApprovalReflection.semantics: required/not_required/granted/denied; authority missing and denied reason missing remain named guards. denial_reason forbidden for every non-denied verdict.

AuthorizationOutcome.semantics: authorized/pending/failed; transient Workflow fact, never persisted as an order-owned payment status.

SpawnContribution.semantics: Exact committed line/receipt roster plus receiver/create/activate keys. Server verifies digest and allocates grant_id/generation; caller cannot grant authority. S5-01 successor-grant amendment remains later prerequisite.

FulfillmentAcknowledgement.semantics: completed forbids failure/evidence fields; failed requires declared failure and complete evidence through guards. Full expected roster comes from storage, not request.

WorkflowCancel.semantics: Configured Workflow only; reason and complete compensation evidence required even pre-spawn.

TransitionResult.semantics: Exact settled authorized outcome is replayed; sparse commercial version is not operational execution ID. A line insert also returns its server-reserved line_id (D-206).

SpawnSignalResult.semantics: Grant visible only after atomic engine commit; replay returns identical grant identity.

OrderView.semantics: Composition of catalog table schemas under consistent current-parent authority; no attempts/grants/controls, outbox, private diagnostics or historical authority bypass.

OrderVersionView.semantics: Exact committed version with complete schema-2 receipt/query/BillingTerms/selected bindings and exclusions. Separate mutable admin projection. Reserved candidates never readable.

PreviewResult.semantics: Optional-context withholding is successful and retains diagnostics. No stored tax/total or issued activation deadline.

OrderPage.semantics: Authorized keyset page, 1–200/default 50; current acceptance/absence and history share a consistent read.

VersionPage.semantics: Authorized keyset page, 1–200/default 50; current acceptance/absence and history share a consistent read.

LinePage.semantics: Authorized keyset page, 1–200/default 50; current acceptance/absence and history share a consistent read.

AcceptancePage.semantics: Authorized keyset page, 1–200/default 50; current acceptance/absence and history share a consistent read.

AuditPage.semantics: Authorized keyset page, 1–200/default 50; current acceptance/absence and history share a consistent read.

orders_commercial_attempt.idempotency_execution_id: uuid unique; no cascading registry FK
orders_commercial_attempt.prepared_draft_revision: nonnegative bigint on submit; absent on amendment
orders_commercial_attempt.receipt_results: per-line first result identities/digests; no rewrite

orders_fulfillment_grant.audit_id: uuid FK to originating committed audit entry

orders_fulfillment_control.command_results: per-receiver command IDs and first outcomes/evidence

rules: same authorization and guard order for every adapter
no arbitrary public trigger endpoint
persist under aggregate then registry/control locks
public state/version/claims/events unchanged
remote work outside SQL transaction
one nonterminal control per order
recheck current authority/version and exact pending pointer
unknown or unavailable receiver outcome is not a success barrier
hold retains capacity/active service; ordinary terminal requires settled no-active evidence
clear pending pointer only if equal to this control_id
D-182 explicit unknown-outcome exception retains uncertain receiver claims
target recheck under lock
no fulfillment expiry; held fulfillment exempt
draft only
age from creation; no external provisioning
configured Workflow and order:spawn-signal PDP authorization
current committed version; in_fulfillment and recorded spawn
no pending control; current closed predecessor; all keys/intents settled
identical commercial roster; active members fixed; new keys only rebuilt drafts
checked next aggregate generation; no spawn/state/timestamp/cap reset
grant/internal audit sequence/owned settlement commit atomically; no public event

transport.idempotency_key: Idempotency-Key header; printable ASCII 1..255 bytes; no trim or normalization
transport.expected_version: single strong If-Match commercial ETag for REST; positive signed SQL integer in SDK
transport.expected_draft_revision: separate body field extracted into normalized metadata for draft writes/submit; nonnegative bigint; required at submit boundary; omitted draft-mutate stays engine version-conflict after admissibility
transport.security_context: trusted authenticated argument only; never from body
transport.correlation_id: trusted middleware propagation into CallMeta; not idempotency identity
transport.path_identifiers: path only in REST; separate typed SDK arguments; cannot be overridden in body
transport.request_names: snake_case; terms/receipt profiles keep native owner codec; external presentation labels in design are mapped explicitly
transport.success_statuses: create order 201; other mutations/reads/Preview 200 with typed result, including line removal; no 204 or implicit 202
transport.event_payload_names: existing camelCase contract; no body-name conversion of stored receipt/query
